lead: One fixed machine now parses proof bytes into formulas and inference lines internally. The complete finite control panel passed independent review. Building the large checker as a full physical machine remains limited by construction size.
physical_summary: The full selected-tape model of the fixed parser/checker was constructed: 126,775 states, 29 tapes and 595,476 stored transition choices. The complete model occupies 13,421,742 decoded JSON bytes. Stored default descriptors are not expanded Machine5 transitions.

Its genuine protected-input mask was constructed for a one-byte layout control with all 256 values unselected. This layout control is too short to be a complete proof and does not establish physical proof acceptance.
Full physical-machine construction returned UNKNOWN_PHYSICAL_CONSTRUCTION at the original 200,000-state cap. No complete physical model, physical FOL execution or literal proof tiling was produced.

On the separate generic instruction diagnostic, 79 native instructions corresponded to 6,581 selected transitions and 5,645,913 literal physical transitions. That scale difference motivates compact tiles and verified high-level clusters; it is not a comparison of proof-search strategies.
